data.title: EverCommerce Announces an Increase and Extension of its Share Repurchase Program
data.description: Today, EverCommerce Inc. (NASDAQ: EVCM) based in Denver disclosed the approval from its Board of Directors for a $25 million expansion of its existing $300 million share buyback initiative. This decision elevates the total approved budget for repurchases to $325 million, which will be in effect until December 31, 2027. EverCommerce Inc. specializes in streamlining operations and fostering growth for small and medium-sized service businesses.

data.title: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacifico Announces the Execution of Bank Credit Facilities Totaling Ps. 8,000 Million
data.description: Guadalajara, Mexico, September 11, 2026 - Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico, S.A.B. de C.V. (NYSE: PAC; BMV: GAP) has disclosed that it recently secured credit facilities totaling Ps. 8,000 million with various financial institutions.

data.title: Maxim Power Corp. Announces TSX Acceptance of Normal Course Issuer Bid
data.description: On September 11, 2026, Maxim Power Corp. (TSX: MXG) disclosed approval from the Toronto Stock Exchange for a normal course issuer bid (NCIB), allowing the Corporation to buy back and cancel up to 3,173,127 common shares (Shares). With 63,462,546 Shares issued and outstanding as of September 2, 2026, the NCIB accounts for roughly 5% of MAXIM's total Shares by that date. The actual number of Shares eligible for repurchase and the buying schedule will be determined by MAXIM. The NCIB includes a daily limit of 2,389 Shares, representing 25% of MAXIM's average daily trading volume over the past six months, set at 9,557. Moreover, MAXIM can conduct one block purchase exceeding daily repurchase limits every calendar week.

data.title: TWO Announces Offer to Repurchase 9.375% Senior Notes due 2030 and Satisfaction and Discharge of the Related Indenture
data.description: NEW YORK--TWO recently announced their proposal to repurchase 9.375% Senior Notes that are due in 2030, a move that signals the company's focus on managing its debt obligations. Additionally, there was mention of the satisfaction and discharge of the related indenture, indicating further steps taken by TWO to streamline their financial operations. This decision reflects the company's strategic approach and commitment to optimizing their capital structure.

data.title: PMT Site and Lark Electric Combine Civil and Electrical Capabilities Through American Gridwork Partners
data.description: NASHVILLE, Tenn.-- A new partnership has been formed between PMT Site and Lark Electric, merging their strengths in civil construction and electrical services. This collaboration, under the American Gridwork Partners platform, offers customers a comprehensive infrastructure solution encompassing site development, underground utilities, electrical construction, fiber optics, controls, and automation. By joining forces, the two companies aim to provide a wider range of services to clients across various projects. PMT Site's expertise lies in civil construction, while Lark Electric brings its proficiency in electrical work to the table.

data.title: Imperial Petroleum Inc. Declares Dividend on Series A Preferred Shares
data.description: Athens, Greece - On September 12, 2026, Imperial Petroleum Inc. (Nasdaq: IMPP) revealed a dividend declaration of $0.546875 per share on its 8.75% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock (Series A Preferred Shares). This dividend is set to be paid on September 30, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 25, 2026. The payment covers the period from the preceding dividend payment date for the Series A Preferred Shares on June 30, 2026, through September 29, 2026. Imperial Petroleum Inc. is a ship-owning company offering petroleum products, crude oil, and drybulk seaborne transportation services.

data.title: ArrowMark Financial Corp. Announces Q2 Results and Special Distribution of $0.10 and Monthly Cash Distribution of $0.15 per Share for September 2026
data.description: On September 11, 2026, ArrowMark Financial Corp. (Nasdaq: BANX) announced a special cash distribution of $0.10 per share from excess income, along with a regular monthly cash distribution of $0.15 per share for September 2026. The total distribution of $0.15 per share is set to be paid on September 30, 2026, to shareholders recorded on September 23, 2026. Additionally, the special distribution will be paid on December 31, 2026, to shareholders recorded on December 24, 2026. ArrowMark Financial is a closed-end management investment company registered with the SEC.

data.title: Eastern International Ltd. Announces Receipt of Nasdaq Notification Regarding Minimum Bid Price Deficiency
data.description: On September 10, 2026, Eastern International Ltd. (NASDAQ: ELOG), a company based in Hangzhou, China, specializing in professional logistics and construction services, received notice from the Nasdaq Stock Market. The letter stated that due to the closing bid price of the company's ordinary shares consistently falling below $1.00 for 30 consecutive trading days, Eastern International no longer complies with the Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement for continued listing. The Nasdaq Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2) mandates a minimum bid price of $1.00 per share for listing, which the company currently fails to meet.

data.title: Kentucky American Water Completes Major Infrastructure Improvement Projects on North Limestone, Euclid and Fontaine
data.description: In a recent announcement on September 11, 2026, Kentucky American Water revealed the successful conclusion of their water main replacement initiatives in the North Limestone-Euclid-Fontaine regions of Lexington. This substantial infrastructure endeavor focused on enhancing water service dependability in the area.

data.title: EscapeSquid Pursues $2.5 Million Seed Round to Scale Virtual-to-Destination Fitness and Travel Platform
data.description: EscapeSquid, a platform connecting riders with local experiences, made headlines as Xanh Entertainment Inc., the developer behind the platform, revealed plans to secure a $2.5 million seed funding round on September 11, 2026. This funding aims to fuel the next stage of development and expansion for EscapeSquid.

data.title: Trilogy Metals Closes US$35.6 Million Strategic Equity Investment by the U.S. Department of War
data.description: The U.S. government has acquired a 10% stake in Trilogy Metals, a mining company operating in Alaska's Ambler Mining District. This move aims to boost the domestic copper supply. This development was announced in Vancouver, BC, on September 11, 2026. Trilogy Metals Inc., listed on NYSE American as TMQ and on TSX as TMQ, now sees the government as a significant shareholder.

data.title: BIMBO BAKERIES TEAMSTERS OVERWHELMINGLY RATIFY CONTRACT
data.description: More than 200 employees in the New England region successfully avoided a strike by securing a robust contract. Teamsters Local 170 and Local 633 at Bimbo Bakeries reached an agreement with a staggering 90% approval rate. The new deal comes after negotiations earlier this month involving sales and warehouse workers.
